text: Lucia's actress is finally confirmed, two days before GTA 6 even comes out.
text_es: La actriz de Lucía por fin está confirmada, dos días antes de que salga GTA 6.

text: It's Manni L. Perez, the name fans guessed from the very first trailer. The Game Awards just nominated her for Best Performance.
text_es: Es Manni L. Perez, el nombre que los fans adivinaron desde el primer tráiler. The Game Awards la acaba de nominar a Mejor Actuación.

text: And GTA 6 got eight nominations, including Game of the Year, before anyone has even played it.
text_es: Y GTA 6 recibió ocho nominaciones, incluido Juego del Año, antes de que alguien lo haya jugado.

text: Jason's actor still hasn't been revealed. So who plays Jason? Because Lucia's actress
